_comment: The Pip (lqe, LANA.cpp) build the client packages at <resources>/pip (electron-pip-supervisor.js), built by scripts/build-pip.sh on a matching computer with LANA.cpp's distribution contract. The v3.0.0 tag is at this commit; its /health reports the loaded model file, which the supervisor's ready check and the engine's embedding identity need. Change the commit only together with a rebuild of every platform's sha256.
